title: Hogwarts Legacy
description: Hogwarts Legacy is an action RPG built around magical exploration, spell-based combat, and student fantasy immersion. Players learn spells, explore Hogwarts and nearby regions, and pursue a larger mystery within the Wizarding World. This file prepares it as a Nintendo Switch 2 product with four account-based store tiers.
